The Spirit Of Dubai

The exclusive perfume collection The Spirit of Dubai was born in Dubai in 2015. Inspired by Dubai’s rich and diverse cultural heritage, each of the fragrances is a tribute to the city. Perfumes with highly seductive notes which offer the world the opportunity to experience a sensory adventure in the wonderful Dubai. The very high quality of natural raw ingredients creates memorable long-lasting fragrances.

The Spirit Of Dubai – Second generation
Ultra luxury Collection

The Spirit of Dubai Second Generation collection expands the First Generation narrative, covering more traits in an effort to celebrate Dubai.

The perfumer is inspired by the seven wonders of the city: the Sea, the Desert, the Skyline, the Arabian Horses, the Natural Ingredients, Luxury, Arabian Hospitality.

The Spirit Of Dubai – Accord Collection

The Second Generation Accord Collection is a testament to the art of perfumery where each fragrance celebrates the wild beauty of nature through the exquisite allure of amber, vanilla, sandalwood, leather, and woody and floral notes.
An olfactory experience to discover the magic of the most precious ingredients in their full splendor.

Electimuss London
Dare to be yourself

Electimuss is a London based niche luxury brand creating daring and decadent perfumes. Electimuss intense indulgent fragrances, explore power, creativity and sensuality and encourage self-expression.

The perfumes, inspired by the myths and legends of ancient Rome, whisper of epicurean pleasures and extravagances, of ambition and seduction.

OJAR
OJAR pays tribute to the art and rituals of Middle Eastern perfume making

OJAR is derived from the word HOJARI, the world’s finest grade of frankincense resin, which is found in the Dhofar Mountains of Oman.
Frankincense has a rich and ancient history in Oman with a multitude of uses and health benefits.
It is known as an ingredient in perfume and as a resin that is burned and worshipped for its powerful revitalizing and purifying effect on body, mind and spirit.
Frankincense is one of six main ingredient categories in OJAR’s permanent collection.

A marriage of two cultures, two savoirs-faire, encapsulated in one philosophy, perfume as a way of life.
OJAR captures the soul of Oman and the know-how of the West in a beautiful fusion, a true balance of tradition and modernity.
The fragrances are inspired by Oman’s cultural heritage and enriched by the expertise of the renowned perfume house Givaudan.
A collection of unisex fragrances based on six main ingredients, crafted to create a unique journey through the wonders of the Middle East.

Honey / Rose / Frankincense / Oud / Sandalwood / Musk

Ghawali

Ghawali is an oriental perfume brand launched by the Chalhoub Group with the aim of combining the universe of Western niche perfumery with a modern contemporary Arabic style to elevate the olfactory experience to the highest levels.

Ghawali is aimed at a young audience attracted by the opulence of Arabic perfumes with a Western influence.

Ghawali’s identity draws inspiration from key elements of the territory, enhancing design craftsmanship in a new, modern and minimalist Middle Eastern approach, in tune with the consumer’s lifestyle.

Anfasic

Anfasic means “breath” in Arabic. A poetic name that interprets perfume as a gesture of authentic presence, an extension of one’s inner world, and a daily ritual of deep connection with self.

Founded in Dubai and present with more than 50 monobrand boutiques, Anfasic reinterprets the great Arabic olfactory tradition with a modern, refined and cosmopolitan look.

At the core of the Anfasic universe is the concept of “Shay,” an untranslatable Arabic word that evokes the most authentic essence of the person: his presence, his identity, the unique energy that sets him apart.
“Live Shay” is an invitation to live in tune with one’s being. It is not just about wearing a fragrance, but about recognizing one’s own identity in it. Each creation becomes an expression of character, a subtle and powerful way of asserting one’s essence through fragrance.

Birkholz

Birkholz was born out of a family passion for fragrances.

It all began in November 2017, when the Birkholz family decided to transform their perfume production into a brand that could combine creativity with the quality and precision typical of Made in Germany. The line, to date known and appreciated by customers in more than fifty countries around the world, is distinguished by three main features:

Handcrafted production
Each product is handmade at the Birkholz family manufactory.

Fragrances
Multifaceted in character and perfect for layering, the brand’s compositions best reflect the personality of the wearer.

Made in Germany
Precision, quality, performance and perfection in every detail are among the brand’s most important strengths.

THE CREATOR
Philip Birkholz, founder and creative director, combines the sensibility of a perfume sommelier with the experience of the best international noses, resulting in creations inspired by his travels and designed to express the unique personality of those who choose them.

“The best compliment is the smile of those who recognize themselves in our scent.” – Philip Birkholz

THE COLLECTIONS.

CLASSIC COLLECTION
The debut line, opulent and luxurious, tells the world through its intense and unforgettable scents. Minimalist and recognizable design with a touch of color.

ITALIAN COLLECTION

Botanicae

A Journey of Healing

Born with the challenge of capturing a destination in a bottle.

The brand promotes sustainable access to artisanal perfumery, without large-scale, impersonal marketing campaigns or the barriers associated with ultra-luxury.

The History in the Founders’ Own Words

Ready for Africa

We have always been travelers, entrepreneurs, and curious people.

In 2012, we began our journey in the fragrance industry and were fortunate enough to continue our training in the Middle East. There, perfume is part of the culture, and in every home, people know the ingredients, and the art of blending them is passed down from generation to generation.

Alongside multinational companies in the industry, we collaborate with long-established local brands, for which we coordinate the formulation and supply fragrances, while enjoying endless chats over tea.

The United Arab Emirates, Iran, Saudi Arabia, Oman, Lebanon, India, Pakistan… As our experience has grown, so too have the regions where we’ve worked, and we’ve begun traveling throughout East Africa and South Asia. It was an exciting time that taught us to open our eyes to other cultures, their scents, and their traditions.

At the end of 2018, the Mediterranean called us back, and we returned home, where we continue to travel while putting down roots.

Alex Perfume

Alex Perfume’s was born out of the passion of Alessandro Malandruccolo, known as Alex Perfume, Italy’s leading influencer in the world of fragrances.

With over 1.4 million followers on TikTok, 640,000 on Instagram, and 130,000 on YouTube, Alex has turned his passion for perfumery into an exclusive line of fragrances.

Its goal is to offer fragrances of the highest quality that evoke wonder and a sense of well-being, placing passion and artistry first.

His creations are designed by an enthusiast for enthusiasts, to share the authentic essence of perfumery.

Gulf Orchid Cocktail Collection

Seven unique fragrances that blend the art of perfumery excellence with the appeal of international mixology. A collection designed for an audience that seeks intensity, persistence and that “addictive” touch of boldness that turns a perfume into a true must-have.

From gourmand and playful notes to magnetic and sophisticated scents, the Cocktail Collection offers an olfactory variety capable of satisfying every type of customer.

Maison Asrar

MAISON ASRAR’s journey began with a fervent desire to break the mold, a dream to redefine fragrances, and a bold ambition to innovate.

From inception, our mission has been resolute: challenge conventions, push beyond boundaries, and fearlessly pursue creativity. In a remarkably short time, MAISON ASRAR has risen as a luminary in the realm of perfumery, each creation weaving a captivating tale at its core, waiting to be shared with the world.

The essence of MAISON ASRAR lies in its name: “ASRAR,” the Arabic word for “secrets.” Each fragrance we create is more than just a scent—it’s a narrative waiting to unfold, a secret longing to be shared. Like hidden treasures waiting to be discovered, our fragrances invite you on an olfactive journey of mystery and revelation. MAISON ASRAR beckons you to dare to explore the secrets within each bottle, where every scent becomes a unique story waiting to be cherished. Join us as we unveil the mysteries and celebrate the artistry of discovery.

Musk Collection

The Musk Collection is an explosion of colors and scents, an invitation to unleash your personality and express your zest for life. Each fragrance is a unique experience, a sensory journey that will take you to enchanted worlds where sweetness blends with freshness, elegance mixes with lightheartedness, and musk is revealed in all its vibrant energy.

Olibanum
When perfume becomes simple, conscious and committed

This is the story of a brand that was designed with a clear and simple intention. Perfumery – especially in the case of niche brands – has always told stories, but does that lyrical and poetic universe really improve perfume?
Undressing a perfume to discover its pure dimension is the very essence of Olibanum.

To express its creativity and uniqueness, Olibanum has chosen olibanum, a rare resin more precious than gold. Coveted by pharaohs and kings of antiquity, and used for centuries as a sacred offering, it has adorned altars in India, Africa, Europe and Mesopotamia.
As a distinctive note of the Olibanum fragrance collection, the essence of olibanum blends with an emblematic raw material of perfumery.
From India to the Horn of Africa and via the Sultanate of Oman, olibanum resin is harvested by cutting the bark of the Boswellia tree to awaken its woody, aromatic, balsamic, mineral, spicy and citrus tones.

Even if simplicity is not always synonymous with perfumery, it is still one of the pillars of Olibanum. Perfumes that say how they smell and which smell like they say aim to be anything but ordinary.
For each Olibanum fragrance, the composition remains deliberately simple: Olibanum + 1 raw material.

Afnan

Founded in 2007 by Imran Fazlani, Afnan reinterprets luxurious Arabian perfumery with a modern twist. The brand masterfully blends the elegance of Middle Eastern tradition with global trends, creating a unique olfactory dialogue. Afnan’s vision is based on three pillars: distinctive design, high performance (excellent projection and persistence), and an always on-trend approach. With bestselling lines such as 9 AM/PM, Turathi and Supremacy, Afnan offers a wide prestige range that combines high quality and affordability. A global brand, present in 120 countries and loved for its ability to innovate tradition.

Nabeel

A collection of original and sensual fragrances inspired by the culture and traditions of the Middle East, unique perfumes that create an unforgettable olfactory experience.

Each fragrance has been created with high quality ingredients masterfully crafted to achieve a very long lasting and powerful stele. Discover our Arabian perfume collection and find the perfect fragrance for yourself or someone special in your life!

AAA Signature Collection
AAA Signature Collection
by Master Pefumer Asghar Adam Ali

Asghar Adam Ali Signature Collection is a celebration of the unparalleled Middle Eastern tradition of perfumery.
Each fragrance in this collection reminds you of beauty in its purest form.

Whether you are drawn to the delicate sweetness of rose, the warmth of leather or the smoky allure of labdanum, each scent is as unique and unforgettable as the culture that inspired it. When you wear a fragrance from this collection, you are adorning yourself with the essence of a rich and legendary heritage.

Marshoud

Atyab Al Marshoud is a multi-generational company founded in 1925, one of the oldest in the perfume industry in Kuwait and the GCC.

All fragrances are produced in our factory in France, our priority is to create quality fragrances for a unique olfactory experience.

Chris Adams

Modern and versatile fragrances for everyday wear.

Street Origins

IT’S NOT JUST A PERFUME, IT’S YOUR PERSONALITY
For those who speak their mind. For those who never stand still. For those who dare.
Street Origins was born in the chaos of the street, amidst the graffiti raids and freestyle moves.
These are not perfect perfumes: each drop is an act of rebellion, the attitude you carry with you, the community you belong to, the world you create.
In short, you deserve to wear your own perfume.
Just yours. Street Origins, SO: be original.

EVERY DROP IS A CULTURE TO WEAR
Fragrances inspired by 20 cities around the world.
Fragrances that release the energy of Mars and Venus in you!

The Library of Fragrance

The Library of Fragrance è una collezione di circa 300 fragranze che si ispirano ad oggetti ed esperienze della vita di tutti i giorni. Il concept del brand ruota intorno al potere evocativo dell’olfatto: verranno in mente luoghi, momenti, persone ed avvenimenti familiari. Le fragranze The Library raccontano la storia di chi le indossa e non di chi le crea.
Piacevoli da indossare perché semplici e non invadenti, le singole fragranze sono realizzate negli USA con alcool fermentato da mais, senza l’aggiunta di coloranti artificiali, addensanti, emulsionanti e ftalati.
La collezione The Library of Fragrance comprende Acqua di Colonia, Shower Gel, Body Lotion, Bath & Body Oil, Olio profumato roll-on, Olio diffusore per ambiente, Gel Igienizzante profumato, Crema Mani.

The Orientalist

THE ORIENTALIST is not just a perfume brand. It is a window into the true Orient.

It stems from a clear conviction: the East isn’t something you invent—it’s something you tell. Because an oriental fragrance isn’t simply an exotic scent. It’s culture, history, and tradition. The brand aims to bring this reality to an audience seeking something authentic and different.

Each fragrance is a portal—not to vague fantasies or fictional tales, but to real places, fine ingredients, and age-old traditions.

Guiding the way is a deep respect for Eastern culture and a passion for telling its stories just as they are.
